screens.title: 1 · Nudge (#3)
screens.why: A small drag moves the block in time instead of swapping it. Nothing opens up.

pins.label: Hint
pins.text: Dark pill over the lifted card: how far it moves and the hour it lands on, in 5-min steps. New widget DragHint; icon AppIcons.pushed (Phosphor arrowDown).

pins.label: Small = move
pins.text: Every drag starts as a nudge. It stays one while it has moved under 30 min (~52 px) and has not passed the middle of a neighbour card. Up or down, same rule.

pins.label: Snapped run follows
pins.text: Blocks snapped to it (starting within 10 min of its end, as snappedAfter) slide by the same amount, lengths untouched. On drop they all keep their new hours (anchored).

pins.label: Not snapped: stays
pins.text: Past the first real gap nothing moves; the gap shrinks. An event (Aula de inglês) is never moved: the nudge stops before it.

screens.title: 2 · Swap (#3, #1)
screens.why: Past the threshold the drag becomes today's reorder: a place opens and the card takes it.

pins.label: Big = swap
pins.text: Once past 30 min or a neighbour's middle the hint turns into 'Trocar de lugar · <onde>' (AppIcons.swap, Phosphor arrowsDownUp) and stays a swap until let go.

pins.label: Top of a day (bug #1)
pins.text: Today a drop at the top of Amanhã is sent as a place in the queue, and the queue packs it back into today's evening, so the swap 'doesn't work'. Fix: a drop at a day's top lands at that day's first hour (anchored), the card below takes the next.

pins.label: Origin
pins.text: Its old place stays open until it is let go, as now.

screens.title: 3 · Stretch a seam (#2)
screens.why: Hold the line between two blocks and drag it: the one above changes length.

pins.label: Seam handle
pins.text: Hold the bottom edge of a card (its last 12 px plus the pause) and it lifts as an accent line with a grip (SeamHandle). 5-min steps, minimum 5 min.

pins.label: Hint
pins.text: '+15 min · até 16:00' (AppIcons.resize, Phosphor arrowsVertical). Shortening reads '−15 min'.

pins.label: Next follows
pins.text: The block above always wins: it takes the new length. The snapped run below slides along keeping its own lengths. Not snapped: untouched until the edge reaches it.

pins.label: Walls
pins.text: An event below is a wall: the edge stops one pause before it. Works on events above too (their end), never on what is running (that has −15/+15).

screens.title: 4 · Drag off Agora = pause (#5)
screens.why: Carrying the running block away shows Agora as it will be: free.

pins.label: Agora fica livre
pins.text: While the running card is up and aimed below Agora, Agora draws the break with 'Agora fica livre' instead of an empty hole (FreeTile vacated).

pins.label: Pause hint
pins.text: 'Pausar · volta com 23 min' (AppIcons.pause). Dropped back on Agora the hint goes away and nothing changes.

pins.label: Keeps what's left
pins.text: Change: it goes back to the queue owing what is left (23 min), not its whole length, which is what pausing means. Today it owes the whole 50.

screens.title: 5 · Day over (#4)
screens.why: After the working day ends, nothing starts now, and Agora says so.

pins.label: Day over
pins.text: Agora becomes DayOverTile (AppIcons.dayOver, Phosphor moon): when the day ended and when the queue moves again. Before the day starts: 'Seu dia começa às 07:00'.

pins.label: Mudar horário
pins.text: The one way round it: opens the work-day hours (same sheet as Menu). The only accent on the screen.

pins.label: Refused drop
pins.text: A card let go on Agora is refused: the hint dims to 'Agora não: seu dia terminou', a heavy haptic, and the card goes back.

pins.label: Server guard
pins.text: The server refuses start / start:true outside the working day (Portuguese refusal), and never marks tomorrow's task awaitingStart, so no reminder or ▶ for it tonight.
